notes: Defect: promo code/discount amount is not displayed correctly for return trip tickets in Mozio email confirmations. The codebase already has return-trip-specific logic (station swapping in create-reservations.mappers.ts), but mapToSanitizedMozioDispatch passes the discount through without any return-trip adjustment. The fix site is the sanitization mapper that feeds the Mozio confirmation payload.

notes: Openspec provided empty acceptanceCriteria, so all criteria were authored from scratch based on the defect description and technical notes. AC-1 is the core fix: return-trip promo amounts must display correctly. AC-2 guards against regression on one-way trips. AC-3 covers the no-discount edge case. AC-4 ensures consistency between the sanitized dispatch mapper and the existing return-trip line-item modification logic (the files listed suggest these should align). AC-5 addresses graceful handling of malformed/missing discount data. AC-6 covers the zero-value discount edge case. AC-7 ensures end-to-end consistency through the webhook path, since http-mozio-webhook.ts is listed as a relevant file.
